import sys

def main():
    lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin.read().splitlines()]
    
    if len(lines) < 4:
        return
    
    type1 = lines[0]
    val1 = lines[1]
    type2 = lines[2]
    val2 = lines[3]
    
    if type1 == "Integer":
        val1 = int(val1)
    if type2 == "Integer":
        val2 = int(val2)
    
    print(f"Original Pair: ({val1}, {val2})")
    print(f"Swapped Pair: ({val2}, {val1})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
